summary: The approved revised Explore converges Change 3 into one architecture/canonical-diagram continuity capability plus one bounded third DeliveryOperationPackage variant. The plan reuses the exact passed Full Test candidate/execution identity, binds Current/Planned/system-view prestate, and freezes a trusted host that alone owns six fixed derived-description output slots. It explicitly omits the fallback changed-path scanner, arbitrary caller-selected paths, mutation/path frameworks, new candidate/evidence identities, Diagram Registry/Planner/Runtime, new Owner authority, Change 4/5 behavior, and early materialization of D04's real Actual/final system views.
